scope: Post-hoc answer-informed diagnostic on already-scored E4 DEV only; no new labels or predictions
budget: Within each task, total retained tokens at most 128*256. Choose the quality-maximizing K128/K256/K512 independently for each question by dynamic programming using its already observed reference-based score. Include K256 for every question as a feasible fixed-budget baseline.
unit: One image/question group; exact capacity measured in units of 128 visual tokens
tie_break: Sort questions by UTF-8 qid, enumerate K128,K256,K512 in that order, replace a state only on strictly better aggregate score; choose smallest total cost among equal score optima.
outputs: Per-task mean oracle and fixed-K256 scores, observed in-sample difference, allocated K counts, retained-token cost, per-item assignment
limitations: Explicit answer-informed upper bound among these three existing outputs on these observed DEV questions, not a deployable policy or generalization guarantee
Per-task resource constraint and task-specific selection assume information not available at inference
Visual token K is not measured TTFT, FLOPs, GPU memory or equal compute
No uncertainty interval or statistical significance for the same-data optimized diagnostic
No new GT, no CONFIRM or FINAL access
